create.subtitle: Create a clear opportunity and find volunteers who can contribute.
create.coverSubtitle: A clear photo helps volunteers recognize your initiative on the public feed.
create.coverHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
create.coverTypeError: This file type is not accepted. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
create.coverSizeError: This file is larger than 5 MB.
create.basicSubtitle: Clearly state the objective, thematic scope, and narrative of the initiative.
create.titleHint: Keep the title descriptive and actionable for specialist contributors.
create.descriptionHint: Detail the civic purpose, community context, and how voluntary records will be shared openly.
create.whenSubtitle: Define location boundaries and engagement schedules.
create.modeHint: On-site, remote, or hybrid. Locked after publishing.
create.durationHint: Real engagement time behind volunteer hours. At least 1 minute.
create.deadlineHint: Applications close once this date passes.
create.positionsSubtitle: Define the specific roles volunteers can apply for and the deliverables expected from each.
create.positionDescHint: What the volunteer will actually do, day to day.
create.positionSkillsHint: Pick from the shared skill catalog. Leave empty when no specific skill is required.
create.positionSkillsEmpty: No matching skills in the catalog.
create.positionDeliverablesHint: One per line. Each line is stored as a separate deliverable.
create.positionEmpty: No positions yet. Add at least one before publishing.
create.reqSubtitle: Specify baseline readiness volunteers need before applying.
create.prerequisitesHint: One per line. These are stored with the opportunity and shown to volunteers.
create.previewOpenNewTab: View full public preview in new tab
create.checkPositionsMissing: Add at least one position with deliverables
create.publishNote: Saving keeps this opportunity as a draft, visible only to your organization. Publishing makes it visible to volunteers on the public feed.
create.invalidDurationError: Enter a duration of at least 1 minute.
create.endBeforeStartError: The end date must not precede the start date.
create.publishNeedsWork: Complete the publishing checklist before publishing.
create.confirmCancelDescription: This ends the opportunity for everyone.
create.gateLockedError: The publish gate is locked. Decide pending reviews first.
create.fieldLockedError: This field is locked after publishing.
